=== folder
^[[0;1m ^[[0;1;35mRetroBIOS^[[0;1m: Which folder?^[[0m

 RetroArch usually reads its BIOS files from:
 /home/user/.config/retroarch/system
 
^[[0;7;35m > Use this folder^[[0m
   Browse for a folder
   Type a path
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ^[[0;1;35mA/Enter^[[0m Use this folder  ^[[0;2mB/Esc^[[0m Back  ^[[0;2m?^[[0m Help
=== folder-card
^[[0;1m ^[[0;1;35mRetroBIOS^[[0;1m: Where is the SD card?^[[0m

 NextUI keeps its BIOS files at the root of its SD card. Choose the card's top
   folder, the one holding .system.
 No NextUI card is mounted. Insert it, then choose Look again.
 
^[[0;7;35m > Browse for a folder^[[0m
   Type a path
   Look again
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ^[[0;1;35mA/Enter^[[0m Browse  ^[[0;2mB/Esc^[[0m Back  ^[[0;2m?^[[0m Help

=== path
^[[0;1m ^[[0;1;35mRetroBIOS^[[0;1m: Type a path^[[0m

 The folder for RetroArch:
^[[0;7;35m > ~/bios_^[[0m
 
 Ctrl-U clears. Quotes are removed, ~ and variables are expanded.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ^[[0;1;35mEnter^[[0m Use this folder  ^[[0;2mEsc^[[0m Back  ^[[0;2mCtrl-U^[[0m Clear

=== device
^[[0;1m ^[[0;1;35mRetroBIOS^[[0;1m: Device^[[0m

 Choose the board, the chip of the device the games run on. Every board fits
   any device.
 
^[[0;7;35m > (x) h700                                                   named by the card^[[0m
   ( ) bcm2711                                                             rpi4
   ( ) x86_64
   ( ) Every board
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ^[[0;1;35mA/Enter^[[0m Choose  ^[[0;2mB/Esc^[[0m Back  ^[[0;2m?^[[0m Help
=== emulators
^[[0;1m ^[[0;1;35mRetroBIOS^[[0;1m: Emulators^[[0m

 Tick the emulators to install for. With none ticked, every emulator's files
   are installed.
 
   Filter (/ to type)
   [ ] mesen
^[[0;7;35m > [x] pcsx_rearmed^[[0m
   None
   ^[[0;32mDone^[[0m
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ^[[0;1;35mA/Enter^[[0m Tick  ^[[0;2mB/Esc^[[0m Done  ^[[0;2m?^[[0m Help
=== regions
^[[0;1m ^[[0;1;35mRetroBIOS^[[0;1m: Preferred regions^[[0m

 Tick the regions to keep, best first. Where a system has one BIOS per region,
   the best one found is installed. With none ticked, every region's BIOS is
   kept.
 
^[[0;7;35m > [1] North America^[[0m
   [ ] Japan
   None
   ^[[0;32mDone^[[0m
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ^[[0;1;35mA/Enter^[[0m Tick  ^[[0;2mB/Esc^[[0m Done  ^[[0;2mLeft/Right^[[0m Order  ^[[0;2m?^[[0m Help
=== cores
^[[0;1m ^[[0;1;35mRetroBIOS^[[0;1m: Cores^[[0m

 Untick the cores not in use: the platform's own files are always kept, and a
   core with no extra file reads only those.
 
^[[0;7;35m > Filter (/ to type)^[[0m
   [ ] mesen                                                     1 file, 8.0 KB
   [x] pcsx_rearmed                                                 1 file, 4 B
   All
   None
   ^[[0;32mDone^[[0m
